supersession_reason: Before any repricing run, align the reported excess_sharpe_over_rf definition exactly with the independent PR #30 verification convention so the implementation can reproduce its -0.223 reference value. No strategy result was observed under the superseded preregistration.
question: Does the already-frozen CARRY-PNL-0031 mechanism, and the already-rejected CARRY-STACK-0033 idle-capital conversion, still have positive net economics after the displaced cash return is priced with a frozen daily risk-free benchmark?
authorized_change: Accounting benchmark only. No strategy target, asset, weight, cost, funding rule, window, threshold, or execution assumption changes.

risk_free.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
risk_free.calendarization: Parse FRED observations as percent per annum, reindex to every calendar day in the requested closed interval, forward-fill only from the latest in-window observation, and hard-fail if the first requested day has no rate.
risk_free.daily_return_conversion: rf_daily = DTB3_percent / 100 / 365.0; simple daily accrual, compounded through time
risk_free.fallback_series: none; any change to SOFR or another series requires a new preregistered ID
risk_free.persistence: Commit the exact daily risk-free sequence used by the first valid run and source metadata/digest.

metric_definitions.cash_cagr: CAGR of compounded rf_daily over the identical strategy dates using elapsed calendar days / 365.25.
metric_definitions.excess_sharpe_over_rf: excess_cagr_over_rf / excess_ann_vol. This geometric-excess-return convention is frozen to match research/review_2026_08_04/verify_carry_vs_cash.py; also report arithmetic_excess_sharpe_daily_mean as a diagnostic, but it is not the named review metric or a gate.

carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.strategy_return: unchanged canonical 5 bps daily funding-aware CARRY-PNL-0031 return
carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.matched_cash_benchmark_return: DTB3 rf_daily for 100% of NAV on each identical day
carry_pnl_0031_benchmark.net_economics: PASS only if excess_cagr_over_rf > 0. No zero-return hurdle remains.

carry_stack_0033_benchmark.principle: Only carry_scale displaces idle cash. BRRK is unchanged.
carry_stack_0033_benchmark.net_economics: PASS only if combined strategy CAGR minus BRRK-plus-idle-cash benchmark CAGR > 0. Existing 0033 qualification is not retuned.

required_outputs: old published source metrics preserved verbatim alongside restated risk-free metrics
0031 CAGR approximately 2.740% and matched DTB3 cash CAGR approximately 3.165% as an implementation parity check
0031 excess_sharpe_over_rf approximately -0.223 as an implementation parity check
annual carry-vs-cash tables for both source experiments
FRED source digest and requested-window metadata
decision_rule: If CARRY-PNL-0031 fails corrected net_economics, stop the carry research line under discipline #7, mark CARRY-PM-0035 and CARRY-PM-0037 as not required, and do not attempt a funding sign filter, asset removal, basis filter, shorter window, threshold change, leverage change, or any same-window rescue.
prohibited: no window restriction or start-date change
no benchmark substitution after observing results
no threshold tuning after observing results
